cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(CadCoveOndselBridge LANGUAGES CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
if(NOT ONDSEL_SOURCE OR NOT ONDSEL_LIBRARY)
 message(FATAL_ERROR "Set ONDSEL_SOURCE to the pinned checkout and ONDSEL_LIBRARY to its shared library")
endif()
add_executable(cadcove-ondsel bridge.cpp)
target_include_directories(cadcove-ondsel PRIVATE "${ONDSEL_SOURCE}/OndselSolver")
target_link_libraries(cadcove-ondsel PRIVATE "${ONDSEL_LIBRARY}")
# Record the expected upstream checkout without importing FreeCAD's document/GUI.
file(READ "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/upstream.json" PIN_JSON)
string(REGEX MATCH "\"revision\": \"([a-f0-9]+)\"" MATCHED_PIN "${PIN_JSON}")
set(EXPECTED_PIN "${CMAKE_MATCH_1}")
execute_process(COMMAND git -C "${ONDSEL_SOURCE}" rev-parse HEAD OUTPUT_VARIABLE ACTUAL_PIN OUTPUT_STRIP_TRAILING_WHITESPACE RESULT_VARIABLE GIT_RESULT)
if(NOT GIT_RESULT EQUAL 0 OR NOT ACTUAL_PIN STREQUAL EXPECTED_PIN)
 message(FATAL_ERROR "Ondsel checkout does not match upstream.json")
endif()
